name: Glen Eagle Pediatric Dentistry
address: 589 Wilmington West Chester Pike, Glen Mills, PA 19342
hours: Mon to Fri 8 am to 5 pm.
description: Glen Eagle Pediatric Dentistry in Glen Mills, PA is a dental home for children led by Dr. Marc Virtue, a Board Certified Pediatric Dentist, in the Glen Eagle Square Shopping Center.
tagline: A dental home for your child

hero.headline: We know kids
hero.sub: A dental home for your child, where oral health care is comprehensive, accessible, and family-centered, led by Dr. Marc Virtue, Board Certified Pediatric Dentist.

offerings.heading: What a dental home <mark>includes.</mark>
items: Preventive visits, cleanings, and sealants that keep small problems small
Education for families on great oral hygiene and a healthy diet at every visit
Care for infants, kids, and teens, including a first visit built to be easy
Dr. Marc Virtue, Board Certified Pediatric Dentist
Mon to Fri 8 am to 5 pm

story.heading: Prevention is the practice
paragraphs: Glen Eagle Pediatric Dentistry focuses on preventing dental problems by educating families about great oral hygiene and a healthy diet, so most visits stay short and calm.
The office is a dental home in the true sense: one team that knows the child from the first visit through the teenage years.

experience.heading: The first visit
items: Request an appointment online or call; the team explains what to expect.
A tour of the room and a gentle first exam, at the child's pace.
A plan for home care that parents can actually follow.

feature.heading: Board certified, kid focused
feature.text: Dr. Virtue's training is in pediatric dentistry specifically, which changes how a nervous four-year-old experiences the chair.

closing.heading: A dental home for your child
